description: MATLAB routines use a loop formulation and Newton-Raphson solution for water-network hydraulics, with depth-first topology processing. This resource is provided by corneliu37 (repository owner). Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The README says hard-coded network sizes and node identifiers need editing, and nonlinear control elements are excluded. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
